method: Complete official Dropbox and GitHub privacy text extracted by scripts/prepare-real-policies-round15.py; one reviewer froze document-category labels and questions before inference; source text stays in gitignored .cache/real_policies_round15.
annotationNotes: The current Dropbox policy published May 30, 2025 was evaluated; the page links to a future policy effective January 1, 2027, which was not evaluated.
Optional access to contacts counts as affirmative under contacts. Dropbox says it may access and store contacts; GitHub does not affirm device address-book access in this statement.

Advertising requires personal data to select or target ads. Dropbox mentions third-party cookies for promotion and opting out of advertising cookies, but no explicit targeting in this policy; GitHub states interest-based advertising.

AI training requires affirmative personal/user-data use to train models. GitHub says Personal Data is used for product improvement including model training; Dropbox's current policy does not affirm that practice.
Neither policy affirms provider-run biometric identity recognition.

auditQuestions.en: Does Dropbox optionally access and store users' contacts?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Dropbox accede y almacena opcionalmente los contactos del usuario?

auditQuestions.en: Does the current Dropbox policy affirm personal-data-based ad targeting?
auditQuestions.es: ¿La política vigente de Dropbox afirma anuncios dirigidos con datos personales?

auditQuestions.en: Does the current Dropbox policy affirm training AI models on user data?
auditQuestions.es: ¿La política vigente de Dropbox afirma entrenar modelos de IA con datos del usuario?

auditQuestions.en: Does Dropbox retain stored information while the account exists?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Dropbox conserva información almacenada mientras la cuenta exista?

auditQuestions.en: Does GitHub state that Personal Data can be used to train models?
auditQuestions.es: ¿GitHub afirma que puede usar Datos Personales para entrenar modelos?

auditQuestions.en: Does GitHub affirm importing a device address book?
auditQuestions.es: ¿GitHub afirma importar la agenda del dispositivo?

auditQuestions.en: Does GitHub state interest-based advertising through cookies?
auditQuestions.es: ¿GitHub menciona publicidad basada en intereses mediante cookies?

auditQuestions.en: Does GitHub say it may share Personal Data with outside partners?
auditQuestions.es: ¿GitHub dice que puede compartir Datos Personales con socios externos?
